feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND (amyloid OR tau OR neuroinflammation OR APOE OR microglia) AND (mechanism OR pathology OR pathogenesis)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer) AND ("p-tau217" OR "plasma biomarker" OR "blood biomarker" OR "amyloid PET" OR "GFAP") AND (diagnosis OR detection OR screening)

feeds.term: (Alzheimer OR dementia) AND (prevention OR diet OR exercise OR "cognitive reserve" OR lifestyle OR "physical activity") AND (cohort OR "risk factor" OR longitudinal)

feeds.title: 新手村 · 入门综述
feeds.term: ("Alzheimer Disease"[Mesh]) AND ("Review"[Publication Type]) AND (overview OR introduction OR "current understanding" OR primer OR basics)

drug.title: Plasma P-tau217 for detecting amyloid clearance after donanemab in Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: 血浆p-tau217难以可靠监测donanemab治疗后淀粉样蛋白清除。

drug.title: A randomized phase 1b/2 trial of ABBV-916 in adults with early Alzheimer's disease.
drug.zh: ABBV-916呈剂量依赖性快速清除脑内淀粉样蛋白，但高剂量安全性受限。

drug.title: Lecanemab use in Chinese patients with Alzheimer's disease: a 12-month multicenter real-world study.
drug.zh: 中国患者使用仑卡奈单抗12个月CDR-SB无显著变化，安全性可控但停药率较高。

drug.title: Eligibility for Anti-Amyloid Therapies in Patients With Biomarker-Confirmed Atypical Alzheimer Disease Phenotypes.
drug.zh: 非遗忘型不典型阿尔茨海默病多数符合抗淀粉样蛋白治疗入组标准，但需注意排除标准限制。

drug.title: Classification of tau status with machine learning models in amyloid-positive cohorts.
drug.zh: 基于MRI和淀粉样PET特征构建的机器学习模型可有效预测淀粉样阳性人群的tau病理状态。

drug.title: Cognitive-enhancing drugs in Phase II clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease: emerging therapeutic candidates.
drug.zh: II期促认知药多数疗效有限，亟需改进试验设计与生物标志物分层。

drug.title: Exploring the Therapeutic Potential of Chalcones in Alzheimer's Disease: Mechanistic Insights and SAR Perspectives.
drug.zh: 查尔酮母核经卤代或三氟甲基修饰可增强多靶点抗AD活性，构效关系明确。

drug.title: Pharmacological and Clinical Heterogeneity of Anti-Amyloid Monoclonal Antibodies in Early Alzheimer's Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Trials.
drug.zh: 抗淀粉样单抗对早期AD疗效与安全性高度异质，临床获益有限且不良反应显著。

mech.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists, metabolic syndrome, and Alzheimer's disease: Lessons and opportunities from the EVOKE trials.
mech.zh: GLP-1受体激动剂或可降低代谢综合征人群的阿尔茨海默病风险。

mech.title: Integrative transcriptomic and genetic analysis implicates fatty acid metabolic reprogramming in perivascular macrophages in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 脂肪酸代谢重编程经血管周巨噬细胞驱动阿尔茨海默病风险。

mech.title: Attenuation of Tau Hyperphosphorylation by Chronic Toxoplasma gondii Infection in a Mouse Model of Alzheimer's Disease.
mech.zh: 慢性弓形虫感染通过免疫调控减轻5XFAD小鼠tau过度磷酸化。

mech.title: Unique transcriptomic alterations in 5XFAD;PS19 mouse model identify glial lipid dysregulation and coordinated microglial-oligodendrocyte responses.
mech.zh: Aβ与tau共病理驱动胶质脂质代谢紊乱及小胶质-少突胶质协同反应，最贴近人类AD。

mech.title: Semantic fluency predicts survival of memory clinic patients.
mech.zh: 语义流畅性可预测记忆门诊患者生存期，且独立于淀粉样蛋白及神经退行性影像标志物。

mech.title: Energetic crisis, mitochondrial vulnerability and disruption of lactate shuttle in Alzheimer's disease.
mech.zh: 阿尔茨海默病早期即出现脑能量危机与乳酸穿梭障碍，先于神经退行性改变。

mech.title: Metabolic dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease: Mechanisms, markers, and therapeutic prospects.
mech.zh: 代谢紊乱先于Aβ和tau病理，是AD早期关键驱动因素及治疗靶点。

mech.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
mech.zh: 帕金森病与阿尔茨海默病均存在脑能量代谢异常，且与神经心理损害相关。

dx.title: From clinical phenotypes to molecular precision: multimodal biomarkers for progressive supranuclear palsy.
dx.zh: 多模态生物标志物将进行性核上性麻痹的临床表型与分子病理精准对应，助力早期诊断与疾病监测。

dx.title: Neurobiological markers across joint profiles of subjective cognitive decline and objective cognitive function in older adults.
dx.zh: 主观认知下降与客观认知功能不一致的老年人，其神经损伤及脑老化标志物水平存在显著差异。

dx.title: Electrochemical profiling of plasma pTau-181 levels associated with mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease using an MXene-gold nanorod interface.
dx.zh: MXene-金纳米棒界面电化学传感可灵敏检测血浆pTau-181，助力AD及MCI早期诊断。

dx.title: Semantic fluency predicts survival of memory clinic patients.
dx.zh: 语义流畅性可预测记忆门诊患者生存期，且独立于淀粉样及神经退行影像标志物。

dx.title: Concordance between plasma biomarkers of phosphorylated tau and tau-PET: A narrative review.
dx.zh: 血浆p-tau与tau-PET一致性随疾病分期及标志物类型而异，且p-tau231早于p-tau217出现。

dx.title: Interactive Effects of Plasma Alzheimer Disease Biomarkers and White Matter Hyperintensities on Cognitive Decline and Clinical Progression in Nondemented Adults.
dx.journal: Journal of the American Heart Associatio
dx.zh: 血浆AD生物标志物与白质高信号协同加速非痴呆人群认知衰退及痴呆进展。

dx.title: Ultrasensitive detection of blood-based p-tau217 for Alzheimer's disease integrated antibody-oligonucleotide conjugates and RCA/Cas12a system.
dx.zh: 基于抗体-寡核苷酸偶联物与RCA/Cas12a系统，实现血液p-tau217超灵敏检测（达1 fg/mL）。

dx.title: Valine modulates Alzheimer's disease risk in APOE ε4 carriers: evidence from two cohorts.
dx.zh: 缬氨酸与APOE ε4交互作用影响阿尔茨海默病风险，或为ε4携带者提供干预靶点。

prev.title: Probing effect modification by socioeconomic status in associations between blood biomarkers of neuropathology and cognitive outcomes in the United States and India.
prev.zh: 美印两国数据显示，社会经济地位显著调节血液神经病理标志物与认知结局的关联。

prev.title: Risk factors and hospital harm: A study of hip fracture patients in the community using population-based data.
prev.zh: 社区髋部骨折老人住院伤害风险与个体及社区因素相关。

prev.title: Mapping the Synaptome in Neurodegeneration: Emerging Clinical Applications of SV2A PET Imaging.
prev.zh: SV2A PET成像可活体量化突触丢失，有望成为神经退行性疾病早期诊断与疗效监测的生物标志物。

prev.title: Combined social determinants of health, mortality, and adverse health outcomes in early natural menopause.
prev.zh: 早期自然绝经女性的不良健康结局风险受综合社会健康决定因素显著调节。

prev.title: A Narrative Review: Suvorexant's Role in Sleep Deprivation and Neurodegenerative Disease.
prev.zh: 苏沃雷生通过改善睡眠，可能延缓阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病的认知衰退。

prev.title: Disparities in mammography screening adherence in a universal welfare healthcare system: A population-based cohort study of 100,000 women.
prev.zh: 即使在全民医保体系中，乳腺钼靶筛查依从性仍受社会经济和临床因素显著影响。

prev.title: Intellectual disabilities and risk of dementia: A Korean population-based cohort study.
prev.zh: 韩国智障人群痴呆风险为常人5.75倍，阿尔茨海默病风险5.23倍。

prev.title: Lasting effects of redlining: The association of historical redlining and cognitive function in older Black adults.
prev.zh: 历史红线划区与黑人老年人认知衰退显著相关，提示居住隔离遗留影响晚年脑健康。

intro.title: Brain energy metabolism changes and neuropsychological impairment in Parkinson disease vs Alzheimer disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑“没电”会让人记性变差、反应变慢，帮你看懂帕金森和阿尔茨海默病为啥都跟脑子缺能量有关。

intro.title: A comprehensive review on therapeutics and diagnostic agents targeting acetyl and butyryl cholinesterases for AD.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正在研发能提升大脑“记忆信使”水平的药物和检测方法，帮阿尔茨海默病患者延缓记性变差，普通人了解后能更早识别并配合治疗。

intro.title: Metabolic therapeutic targets in Alzheimer's disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述想告诉你，老年痴呆可能和大脑“吃不饱饭”有关，了解这点，或许能帮我们提前预防或延缓它。

intro.title: Discovery of Anti-Neuroinflammatory Compounds in Alzheimer's Disease: Current Trends and Future Perspectives.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是，科学家正研究用“消炎”的办法来对付老年痴呆，给未来新药研发指了个新方向。

intro.title: Mechanisms, Biomarkers and Therapeutic Implications of Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's Disease.
intro.zh: 这篇综述讲的是大脑发炎会加速老年痴呆，看懂它，就能明白为啥控炎症、查血指标，可能帮咱早防早治。

intro.title: Further data to address the Alzheimer's coverage with evidence development questions.
intro.zh: 这篇综述用最新数据回答了“抗淀粉样蛋白药到底值不值得用”的问题，帮普通患者和家属判断治疗利弊。

intro.title: Neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases: pathogenic mechanisms and therapeutic strategies.
intro.zh: 大脑发炎会加重老年痴呆和帕金森病，这篇综述帮普通人看懂病因，并提醒别指望现有药物能专治这种炎症。

intro.title: Network Biology of Alzheimer's Disease and Related Neurodegenerative Disorders: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Strategies.
intro.zh: 这篇综述把老年痴呆等脑病看作一张互相牵连的“坏网”，讲清各环节如何联手破坏大脑，帮普通人看懂病因，也指明未来防病治病的新方向。
